More dates and map collections

Additional archive scans (PDFs, outside the comparison viewer):

1808 · French geographers 1825 · Ambroise Tardie 1860 · Castro’s Ensanche 1866 · José Pilar Morales

  • Madrid en sus planos has further dates from 1800 onward.
  • Castro’s Ensanche plan, 1859–1861 shows the proposed expansion beyond the old city; a project plan describes intentions, not everything already built.
  • The national topographic series, from 1875 provides repeated editions rather than isolated city plans; Madrid was its first published sheet.
  • Modern municipal mapping has successive vector editions from 1995 onward.

Archive scans linked here are additional sources; they are not aligned comparison layers in this viewer.

Sources, alignment and saved tiles

Original cartography comes from IGN and Ayuntamiento de Madrid / memoriademadrid. Older maps have approximate alignment, different coverage and occasional gaps between sheets. Search finds present-day addresses.

This device saves up to 64 MiB of map tiles. Older tiles are removed automatically.
